sections.title: Extend
sections.topic: How are people and animals different?

parts.title: Look and retell
parts.english: Leon is a fish. Leon can swim. Leon can’t run. I’m a boy. I can run. I can’t swim.

parts.title: Think and discuss
parts.english:
—What animals can you see? —I can see horses. —What do they have? —They have strong legs. —What can they do? —They can run.

—It has wings. Can it fly? —No, it can’t fly.
